name: Last Transmission
description: Help a dying drifter deliver his final message.|A wounded survivor in the dunes needs someone to carry his last data disc to his partner before he flatlines.

text: I'm done for. Can't make it another kilometer.
I need one favor before I black out.
Take this data disc to my partner.
Tell her I won't be coming back.
She lives south of the dunes.
Hello? Why are you in my house..?
hasItemText: Who are you and why are you in my house?
Oh my god I knew it, that bastard is cheating on me!
Wait, I can sorta read your thoughts.
Oh no, he's dying. That is super sad
He wanted me to have this CD?
That bastard is still trying to sell his
demo tape even on his death bed.
Tell him I'll take it but will probably never listen to it.

text: Well? Did she get the disc?
She said she'd keep it? Good...
At least my signal reached home before shutdown.
completedText: Farewell, Seeker. This is the end of my route.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Last Transmission@green@. You have gained nothing out of that!
